LanguageData.MST.mutatorChancesComment: Tile mutators rolled when the landmark is placed (each entry is rolled independently). Only affects worlds generated after the change.
LanguageData.MST.comboLandmarkMutatorsComment: Combination mutators: rolled in order, the first success is applied and the rest are skipped (the tile becomes a combo landmark). Only affects worlds generated after the change.
LanguageData.MST.ChanceComment: A value between 0 and 1: the odds that this mutator is applied (1 = always, 0 = never).
